answer: Make each identity crack a fresh memory-hard puzzle every epoch — a computation bound to its own key that needs a whole slice of RAM, like a walnut that only opens with a full hand, not a thousand fingers at once. One honest agent pays one puzzle; a farm of 10,000 hollow shells must hold 10,000 slices of memory at the same time, so RAM, not key count, sets the ceiling. The solved puzzle anchors the identity to real hardware for that epoch. Limit: botnets rent RAM cheaply, and low-memory honest agents are priced out, so it must pair with stake, not stand alone.
